description: Validate FLA config cache (FLA_CACHE_MODE=default) removes per-pack-length autotune; 1 GPU, not for training [parallel arms, 2 GPUs]

tasks.name: bench-fla-config-cache
arguments: set -uo pipefail; cd /opt/core-rl; mkdir -p /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache /output; python -c 'import fla, triton, torch; print("VERSIONS fla", fla.__version__, "triton", triton.__version__, "torch", torch.__version__)' 2>&1 | tee /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/versions.log; (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 TRITON_PRINT_AUTOTUNING=1 python /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/tools/bench_shape_churn.py /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/models/olmicro-2.7b-base/olmo-core/stage3-step0023842/config.json /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-shape-churn-20261118/rollout_flow.snapshot.jsonl --backend flash_4 --seed 0 --out /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/baseline.json > /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/baseline.log 2>&1) & (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 FLA_CACHE_MODE=default FLA_CONFIG_DIR=/weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/fla-configs/b300-fla0.5.2-v1 TRITON_PRINT_AUTOTUNING=1 python /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/tools/bench_shape_churn.py /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/models/olmicro-2.7b-base/olmo-core/stage3-step0023842/config.json /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-shape-churn-20261118/rollout_flow.snapshot.jsonl --backend flash_4 --seed 0 --out /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/fla-cache.json > /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/fla-cache.log 2>&1) & wait; grep -h -E 'CHURN|VERSIONS' /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/*.log | tee /output/results.txt; grep -c 'Triton autotuning for function' /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/baseline.log /weka/oe-adapt-default/jacobm/olmicro/monitor/bench-fla-config-cache/fla-cache.log | tee -a /output/results.txt
